name: whats-new-claude
description: Tells you which new Anthropic releases matter to your own projects, rated 0 to 10 per project, with top picks for the project you are in and one-step briefs.

update_frequency.title: Background update frequency
update_frequency.description: How often to check Anthropic's sources in the background when a session starts. 'manual' never checks on its own. /whats-new always updates now, whatever this is.

min_rating.title: Top picks threshold
min_rating.description: Items rated at least this (0 to 10) are your top picks, shown by /whats-new here, the reminder and the page.

auto_rate_max_calls.title: Background rating budget (Claude calls per update)
auto_rate_max_calls.description: Claude calls a background update may make on your account to review and rate new items. 0 = never spend in the background; new items wait for /whats-new. Suggested: daily 10, every 3 days 20, weekly 40.

max_calls_without_asking.title: Ask before more than this many Claude calls
max_calls_without_asking.description: When you run /whats-new, it asks first if reviewing and rating would take more Claude calls than this.

reminder.title: Session-start reminder
reminder.description: Show a one-line count of top picks when a session starts (numbers and a link only).

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: A read-only GitHub token raises GitHub's rate limit for background updates. Kept in Claude Code's secure storage, sent only to api.github.com.
